aiOverview.content: Mohammed bin Salman (MBS), born August 31, 1985, is the de facto ruler, Crown Prince, and Prime Minister of Saudi Arabia. Son of King Salman, he holds immense wealth and centralized power. Married to Princess Sarah bint Mashhoor with multiple children, he is known for his Vision 2030 economic plan, social reforms, and assertive foreign policy. Key Details of Mohammed bin Salman (MBS): Birth Date: Born August 31, 1985. Family Background: He is the seventh son of King Salman bin Abdulaziz and his third wife, Fahdah bint Falāḥ ibn Sulṭān. Spouse: He is married to Princess Sarah bint Mashhoor bin Abdulaziz Al Saud. Children: He has five children. Net Worth: While his personal net worth is not publicly disclosed, he controls a massive fortune through the Saudi Royal Court and oversees the Public Investment Fund (PIF). Role: As Crown Prince (appointed 2017) and Prime Minister (appointed 2022), he is the functional leader of Saudi Arabia. Background and Policies: Vision 2030: MBS is driving an ambitious plan to diversify the Saudi economy away from oil dependency. Social Reform: He has spearheaded significant social changes, including lifting the ban on women driving and reducing the powers of the religious police. Foreign Policy: Known for an aggressive foreign policy, particularly regarding Iran and the war in Yemen. Controversy: His tenure has been marked by the 2018 killing of journalist Jamal Khashoggi and the consolidation of power through crackdowns on critics and rivals.
